name: Kingboard Laminates Holdings Limited
summary: Kingboard Laminates Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture and sale of laminates in the People's Republic of China, Europe, other Asian countries, and the United States. It operates through Laminates, Properties, and Investments segments. The company offers glass epoxy and paper laminates. It also provides upstream component materials, such as copper foils, glass yarns, glass fabrics, bleached kraft papers, epoxy resins, kraft papers for copper-clad laminates, and PVB.
